custom_logic_notes: NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) logic: The EA maintains an internal channel based on ATR*KATR multiplier. When price breaks above the upper channel, trend becomes UP and a long is opened; when price breaks below the lower channel, trend becomes DOWN and a short is opened. The channel only moves in the direction of the trend (ratcheting), never retreating. On trend reversal, the existing position is closed and a new opposite position is opened. The KATR multiplier (default 2.0) controls channel width. Periods input (default 14) sets the ATR calculation period. This is a trend-following system with ATR-based dynamic trailing stops and signal-reversal exits.
python_conversion_notes: The NRTR channel state must be maintained across bars (trend direction, upper/lower channel values) as it is a stateful indicator. Implement as a class with update() method. ATR uses built-in calculation. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be handled. The trend direction enum (UP/DOWN) and channel ratcheting logic (only move in trend direction, reset on reversal) are the core state machine. Entry is simply: on new bar, if trend changed direction, close existing and open opposite. Trailing stop is updated each bar to the NRTR channel level.
